'''Saahir Ru'luv''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] singer. She once performed the song "''[[Laughter After Dark]]''" and was a sympathizer of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]].<ref name="LAD" />

While arranging a gunrunning operations with her fiancé, [[Juri Marbra]], their last mission for the Rebellion before their deaths, they hired Saahir's true love, [[Thaddeus Ross]], and [[Trep Winterrs]] to haul a munitions cargo including 500 [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] aboard the ''[[Kierra]]'' to a hidden Rebel base.<ref name="LAD" />
